% Pattern: number/prime. A head in bold numbers a variant of a statement with
% a prime, as "Theorem 1B'", or with a letter after a reference to it, as
% "Theorem {\ref{main}A}", which prints the number of the label and the
% letter. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want head-1 statement/theorem 1.1A
% want head-2 statement/theorem 2'
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{thm}\label{main} Every compact space is bounded. \end{thm}

\noindent {\bf Theorem {\ref{main}A}} {\em Every closed part of a compact
space is bounded.}

\noindent {\bf Theorem 2'} {\em A closed part of a compact space is compact.}
\end{document}
